# WeekCalendar

A week of an activity plan: the days across (today marked), each activity's days down: planned (a ring), partly done (tinted) or done (teal with a tick).

<!-- rules:start — GENERATED by tools/build_tokens.py from design/components.json -->
## Rules (every product)

- Days Monday to Sunday with their dates; today's column on lilac.
- Planned: a ring in the activity's line colour. Partly done: its tint, solid ring. Done: teal with a tick. Not planned: nothing.
- Never colour alone: done has a tick, and each day is read out (Monday, Morning routine: done).

Tokens: `component.calendar` (planned, partial, partial-line, done-fill, done-ink, today, ink, day-ink) in design/tokens.json.

| Product | Implementation |
|---|---|
| Website | none: The website has no plans. |
| Design System | `.fmt-calendar`, `<WeekCalendar>` |
| App | `FmtWeekCalendar` |
